newsitem.title: UK: Major easily wins parliamentary vote on budget.
newsitem.headline: Major easily wins parliamentary vote on budget.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major won an important parliamentary vote on Tuesday, when an opposition Labour party amendment to the finance bill implementing the 1997/1998 budget was easily defeated by 322 votes to 287.
The vote was the first stern test for Major since he lost his overall parliamentary majority last month.
A defeat for the government, which would have triggered a vote of confidence, was never likely.

But the 35-vote margin of victory will be a boost to Major, who wants to solider on and delay Britain's general election until May -- the last possible month -- to give more time for the strong economy to revive his Conservative party's fortunes.
